claim: Keeping the same number of principal components as original covariates is a standardized orthogonal rotation, not dimensionality reduction; new samples must be projected with the scaler and loadings fitted during the sampling-design workflow.
conditions: Applies to the current five-covariate to PC1-PC5 implementation.
limitations: PCA is unsupervised and variance retention does not prove predictive relevance for any nutrient target.
recommended_action: Freeze and version the center, scale, loading matrix, retained components and covariate order; compare PC-based models by nested spatial validation.
not_allowed_action: Do not refit PCA on sample_actual or describe five retained PCs from five variables as dimension reduction.
